fusions.name: Flung Dirt
fusions.desc: Scratches up a clod and flings it, dealing 4 damage and leaving the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds. Your movement speed rises 10% for 2 seconds after each throw.

fusions.name: Sweep the Yard
fusions.desc: Rakes a wide arc ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Tidy Furrows
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 6 seconds. An escort of chicks fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gleaned Grain
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 8 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
